prompt.text:
Implement a new typed message-rendering API.

Export `StaticMessageKey`, `DynamicMessageKey`, `MessageCatalog`, and overloaded `renderMessage`. Static keys are `"accept"`, `"dismiss"`, and `"emptyReport"`. Dynamic keys are `"matchCount"` and `"range"`. The catalog separates `common`, `report`, and `dynamic` entries as declared in the solution API.

Static calls accept no formatting values. `matchCount` accepts one number. `range` accepts two numbers in start/end order. At runtime, a missing or malformed entry—possible when untyped data is cast to `MessageCatalog`—must return the key unchanged rather than throw. Valid entries must preserve empty translated strings. Do not mutate the catalog or arguments.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
